parent_objective: implement a no-rollout source-coverage repair preflight for T1/T2/T3 panel gaps
blocked_by: M2025 admits source repair implementation before routing smoke
supersedes: direct routing smoke from M2023 unready panel

public_gates: M2026 must not reset the environment or execute policy actions
M2026 must write repaired panel source and coverage artifacts
M2026 must report repair actions and before/after T1/T2/T3/T4/T5 coverage
M2026 must fail closed if clean source repair is impossible
M2026 must keep ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU and level3 self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: attempts no-rollout repair of source coverage gaps before any execution
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: no-rollout source repair only; no driver performance mechanism ranking paper or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if repair uses hidden/oracle actor inputs
stop if repair drops T4/T5 passing coverage without explicit audit
stop if repair claims routing-smoke readiness without coverage proof
stop if environment rollout or policy action occurs
fallback_plan: route to result audit if repair artifacts are generated
route to threshold/source-generation audit if clean repair is impossible
route to synthesis if source repair becomes another local loop
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2025 admits source coverage repair implementation

admission_evidence: M2025 defines no-rollout repair rules and candidate source artifacts
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window-vs-GRU or paper-level evidence
allowed_updates: M2026 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for result audit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2026 repairs source coverage only and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M2026.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2023 panel sources plus M2025 repair design.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If repair is partial or fails closed, route to audit rather than execution.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: attempts to add source diversity before public routing smoke
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can determine whether the panel can become routing-smoke-ready from existing public artifacts
must_synthesize_if: M2026 cannot improve T1/T2/T3 source coverage
M2026 repairs only by weakening thresholds
M2026 would need a second source repair loop without new artifacts

hypothesis: A no-rollout repair implementation can improve or fully fix T1/T2/T3 source coverage using existing public artifacts.
success_criteria: repaired panel source coverage and repair action artifacts exist
no rerun ranking finite-window-vs-GRU paper-level or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: repair changes actor inputs or controller profiles
environment rollout or policy action execution occurs
ranking or finite-window-vs-GRU claims are made

commands.name: implement_and_run
commands.command: implement focused no-rollout controlled comparison source coverage repair and run it on existing public artifacts

decision_rule: M2026 passes if it writes clean source-repair artifacts and preserves claim boundaries.
